loop_probation_ending.detect: A probation ends within 14 days with no decision recorded. Checked every night.
loop_probation_ending.diagnose: Whether a review is open, and with whom: not started, with the manager or with HR.
loop_probation_ending.prepare: A confirmation review card for HR. HR records the decision; the loop never decides.
loop_probation_ending.verify: Closed when a decision is recorded. A new end date with no decision reopens it.

loop_payroll_inputs.detect: From the start of the payroll period to the cut-off, at each company's interval: timesheets, overtime, leave, claims, joiners and leavers, bank and statutory details, pay changes and payroll set-up.
loop_payroll_inputs.diagnose: Each check's open, waiting and to-review items, read from the owner of each.
loop_payroll_inputs.prepare: A case for payroll administrators on the Payroll cycle page, and a Today card in the last 7 days before the cut-off. Each check links to the page where it is fixed.
loop_payroll_inputs.verify: Done when nothing is open or waiting before the cut-off. A new blocker before the cut-off reopens it.

loop_missing_employee_data.detect: An employee record is missing details that payroll or statutory filing needs.
loop_missing_employee_data.diagnose: Which of them the employee may fill in through a profile change request.
loop_missing_employee_data.prepare: A request card for the employee. HR approves the request as usual.
loop_missing_employee_data.verify: Closed when nothing the employee can fill in is missing. A gap that comes back reopens it.

loop_missed_clock_outs.detect: A day in the last 7 days with a clock-in and no clock-out.
loop_missed_clock_outs.diagnose: The roster end time for that day, which the card proposes.
loop_missed_clock_outs.prepare: A correction card for the employee, who confirms the time or changes it. Their approver decides as usual.
loop_missed_clock_outs.verify: Closed when a clock-out is on record. A rejected correction reopens it.

loop_document_expiry.detect: A recorded passport expires within 60 days.
loop_document_expiry.prepare: A Today card for HR and a reminder card for the employee to renew it.
loop_document_expiry.verify: Closed when a renewed expiry date is recorded. An expiry moved back into the window reopens it.

loop_salary_payroll.detect: After the cut-off, each company's runs for the month: salary, bonus and off-cycle. A run not yet started is prepared for HR to start.
loop_salary_payroll.diagnose: The 11 anomaly checks, the change against last month by cause, net-swing flags, statutory rule versions and the bank file against net pay.
loop_salary_payroll.prepare: A case per run for payroll administrators, and a flag per person for payroll HR to mark expected or a real problem. It never runs, approves or closes payroll.
loop_salary_payroll.verify: Done when a person has closed the run and the bank file matches. A run reopened after close reopens it.

method.summary: How it's measured: hours freed = work done × your own manual time per item (measured from the event log before Autopilot) − the time people spent reviewing. Nothing is estimated from industry averages.
method.work: Work done: every loop card a person completed in the period, every employee question AI Centre answered, and every action AI Centre prepared that a person confirmed. Payroll errors caught are anomaly findings fixed before the payroll run closed; they are counted, not turned into hours.
method.baseline: Your manual time each comes from your baseline: a period before Autopilot started in the company. For missed clock-outs and missing employee data, the event log measures the staff actions per case in that period (attendance corrections and profile changes), and your minutes per staff action turn them into time. For other work, it is the minutes you entered. A company without a baseline counts its work as done, freeing no time.
method.review: Review time: for each item, the time between AI Centre preparing it and a person confirming it, up to {cap} minutes and never more than the item's own manual time. A longer gap means the item waited, not that someone worked on it. A loop records the confirmation when it next checks, so most items count the full allowance: the ledger under-states the time freed rather than over-states it. Answered questions have no review step.
method.arithmetic: Hours freed = work done × your manual time each − review time, per company with its own baseline, then added up. A working day is {hours} hours.
method.access: HR and group administrators see this for the companies they administer. Question and confirmed-action counts come from AI Centre's outcome records, which only group administrators may read across people, so other administrators do not see them.
method.records: Every figure comes from the records: loop cards, outcome records and payroll anomaly findings, read with your own access. Nothing is estimated from industry averages.

how.title: How it works
how.description: How the AI is built, what it may do, and who decides.
how.mapLabel: The AI's layers: interfaces, agentic harness, context and knowledge, HR capabilities and the HR system of record, on a foundation of trust and governance.

layers.interfacesHelp: Chat, floating chat, Today, review pages
layers.harnessHelp: Runs each turn within limits. The model works inside it.
layers.contextHelp: Guides, pages, setup readiness, your role
layers.capabilitiesHelp: Reads, explainers, preparers and the workers
layers.recordHelp: Leave, payroll, people, claims. The only place figures and permissions are decided.

steps.s0Body: Five layers sit on one foundation. Every question, card and background job takes the same path, so there is one place to secure and one to audit.
steps.s1Body: Aina asks the floating chat a question about her own leave.
steps.s2Body: Before any model sees the question, code checks it.
steps.s2c1: AI is on for this company
steps.s2c5: No hidden instructions in the text
steps.s3Body: The model receives the question and only the tools Aina may use. Every tool call is checked again as Aina.
steps.s3c1: Offered: her leave balance, read as Aina
steps.s3c4: Not offered: anything that completes a change
steps.s4Body: It knows the leave guide, the right page and Aina's role. A role is context, never permission.
steps.s5Body: The leave preparer asks the leave service to check the request. Nothing has changed yet, and the model computes no figure.
steps.s6Body: The leave service checks the request against the company's current rule version. Only here are days and money calculated.
steps.s7Body: Who asked, what was read, which rules ran and which model worded the reply are stored with the audit trail. The request waits on its review page.
steps.s8Body: Aina opens the review page and confirms. Her confirmation, not the AI, submits the leave.

jobs.k1Body: An administrator chooses which jobs may be delegated at all, with limits. By default none are.
jobs.k2Body: Within their own authority, for a set period, with limits and a choice of notifications.
jobs.k3Body: For them, never as them: every record names who delegated and which worker acted. Authority is checked again at every run.
jobs.conditions: Conditions are code, never the model
jobs.conditionsBody: Balance, overlap, coverage and amount checks are run by the system of record. Anything unusual goes back to the person as needs review.

families.intro: Every worker belongs to one family and follows one contract: a trigger, a declared read scope, a declared effect, the authority it runs under, an outcome record per run, and a switch that starts off.
families.deciderRole: AI: no part in the decision

never.n1Body: No judgements about attitude, performance or who might resign.
never.n2Body: Figures come from the payroll and leave services, never from the model.
never.n5Body: Only declared tools, each checked against your permissions.
never.n6: Send identity numbers to a provider
never.n6Body: IC, passport, bank and tax numbers never leave.

stepText.capture: For every run, regular, bonus and off-cycle: its inputs, each change from draft to final with who and why, adjustments, rule versions, exceptions, approvals, bank and statutory files, filings, payslip opens, corrections, who viewed or exported pay data and configuration changes. Each copy is hashed and chained.
stepText.check: Seven control checks every night, each with its evidence. Nothing is blocked or changed.
stepText.prepare: Findings for a payroll administrator to dispose of, a root cause for each correction, and the audit pack per company.
stepText.verify: Payslips released, statutory files prepared before {due} and filed with a receipt, corrections at zero, and every capture unchanged.
